en: Wait, Sil.
There's something here that's caught my attention...
Rims, we don't have time for that right now.
Sniff, sniff... Sniff, sniff...
Seriously... What are you doing?
No, I mean... this damaged artifact...
I can faintly feel the Jewel Witch's power in it.
Take a look.
Y-You don't feel anything?
Hmm... I don't know.
My senses aren't as sharp as yours.
Hmm... Am I imagining it?
If it bothers you that much, let's take it for now.
Bazira might know something.
Th-Then while we're taking it, maybe we could quietly grab some other valuables...
I said we don't have time for that.
Sniff, sniff...
I can sense a witch's trace around here.
But it's a dead end.
It seems the trace is coming from this artifact...
Tch, how misleading.
In other words, it's an item the witch put a lot of work into.
Let's take it to the conservator.
Like the other artifacts, it might be useful somehow.
It might be a clue to finding the Jewel Witch.
Let's take it, just in case.
Wow! Look, Sil.
It's a huge jewel!
I said don't touch things without permission.
Let's just see...
I-It crumbled.
Sigh, I knew that would happen...
Let's take it to the conservator.
They'll restore it to its original form.
If it was displayed so carefully in a place like this, there must be a reason.
It's broken now, but let's take it with us.
Hehe, even gathering the valuables around here would fill our pockets.
And on top of that, there's a valuable-looking artifact just sitting here.
Before long, we could use this as capital to renovate our club... Hehe.
I think you're misunderstanding our objective...
We're only taking it because it might help us find the Jewel Witch.
Oh, of course I know that.
If it's restored to its original form, it'll fetch a much higher price, right?
Heh heh heh...
Sigh, honestly.
I'm only interested in what this artifact can do.
In that spirit, shall we grab this one too?
Don't blame me if the owner gets mad later.
Cough, cough!
Ugh... It feels like dust and poison fog have soaked into my whole body.
D-Don't worry. It's not that bad.
What, did you save me?
You could say that.
Suspicious... You didn't touch my body, did you?
I was thinking of keeping one toe as a specimen.
What?!
I-I'm joking.
...Forget it. I can't believe this happened to us...
Where is Bazira? I need to have a word with her.
Oh my, oh my~
Is your search going smoothly~?
How bold of you to show your face...
Going smoothly, you ask?
It would have gone a lot more smoothly if you'd told us everything you knew about that realm.
Well, I made it out fine.
Sil seems thoroughly angry.
That's right. You tricked us.
Oh my, tricked you?
I was merely placing my trust in you all.
In particular, I had heard rumors that Sil survived even inside a nightmare.
So I assumed traps of that level would be no issue...
The rumors are exaggerated.
Compared to that, Rims looks perfectly well!
Impressive, as expected~!
You might even be exceptional among the witches I have seen...
R-Really? Hehe...
R-Really... Talent just can't be hidden.
Good grief... How can you fall for her flattery so easily?
Please do not be so harsh. As an apology, I will give you something useful.
Would you accept this?
What is it?
It is a tool that detects poison fog.
With it, you should be able to tell which places in the ruins are dangerous.
Do you have a tool that protects us from the poison fog?
If such an item existed, we would very much like to obtain it ourselves.
It is the only one we have, so please handle it with care!
It's better than nothing... I'll take it for now.
Phew... We'll need to choose our route carefully from now on.
Whoa!
Ugh... That chilling feeling. I really can't get used to it.
Did you have a comfortable trip?
No...
Waking up trapped in a narrow coffin isn't exactly pleasant.
Should I decorate the inside nicely for you?
That's not the issue.
Ugh, I nearly died.
No, you died and came back to life.
If you're going to keep going back and forth between life and death, why not live as half-dead instead?
I'll pass on that...
Hey, you...
You're not hiding anything else about the ruins, are you?
Yes~ Of course not~!
Ah, Sil.
About those artifacts... Why don't we have them checked?
Hmm?
Oh, right! We found those artifacts in the realm.
I forgot about them while we were bickering.
Hmm? Which artifacts do you mean?
This one...
Can you tell what it is?
Oh my, this is one of the works left by the Jewel Witch.
But to damage such a work this badly...
I-It was broken from the start...!
Don't let Bazira drag you along.
Rims says she can feel a witch's presence from it.
Do you know anything?
Perhaps you sensed the power left behind by the Jewel Witch?
Her lingering power?
Yes!
The Jewel Witch is a consummate artisan.
Some of the artifacts she creates are made with particular care...
...and can even retain a trace of her own power, like this one.
Ah, I see.
It should look no different from the other exhibits, yet you distinguished it...
You truly have an excellent eye!
Huh, r-really...?
Rather than an eye, maybe it's my nose that's good... Hehe.
Is there any way we can use this power?
Hmm...
If it undergoes restoration, I believe it could be of use to you.
Restoration?
We have a conservator in our caravan. Would you like to meet them?
You're not going to charge us a hefty fee for it, are you?
Of course not~ Ohoho!
Please think of it as goodwill from an investor!
Then let's go see the conservator.
Hello, ma'am!
Are you the conservator Bazira mentioned?
Yes ma'am, that's me!
Y-You don't exactly look dependable...
Can you really repair broken artifacts?
Of course I can, ma'am!
I can fix just about anything in no time!
Even things I can't fix, I'll find a way if Master orders me to!
That's some impressive loyalty...
So do you all belong to Bazira?
Oh, no ma'am, not that.
Huh? Then why are you in such a remote place...?
If I work hard, Master gives me coins!
Gonna work hard and get lots of coins!
I'll collect lots and lots...
And then use them to collect even more coins!
Hehe... Feels good just thinking about it.
Like witch, like minions.
Yeah... We should probably just talk about the artifacts.
Anyway, you can repair these artifacts, right?
Of course, ma'am!
Just show me the item, ma'am!
Phew — job complete, ma'am!
What is this?
First time I've seen it too, ma'am!
But it's a dangerous weapon for sure!
A weapon?
Looks like a self-defense weapon made by the Jewel Witch.
However, so Sil can handle it...
Made a few adjustments!
Oh?
I might try using it on the pests in the ruins.
But handle it with care, ma'am!
The energy coming off this artifact tingles!
I-Is that so...?
Maybe I'll test whether it works properly on you~?
Waaah~! Boss! Rims is picking on me!
Don't tease them too much.
Hehehe.
Restoration complete!
This is a tool containing a magic spell!
What kind of spell?
No idea, ma'am!
Fix things, get coins! After that, none of my business!
What did you say?
Eek~! Scary when you glare at me, ma'am!
D-Don't worry, Sil.
This magic definitely belongs to the Jewel Witch.
It has the same presence I sensed in the realm.
If we handle it well, it could be useful.
So that's what it is.
All right. More options never hurt.
H-Here's the item you asked for, ma'am!
What's wrong? Why the sudden stammer?
N-Nothing, ma'am! F-Fixed it perfectly!
Suspicious...
Oh~ Really?
Let's see... Maybe I should check if anything's wrong~?
S-Sorry, ma'am...! Made one teeny-tiny mistake!
But it should still work... probably!
Probably...?
D-Definitely, ma'am! It works, no problems!
Hehe, what should I do? Maybe I should tell Bazira...
A-Anything but that!
My pay will get docked...!
Poor thing.
Don't worry. As long as it works properly, there's no problem.
Ah, one second, ma'am!
Master told me to give this to you too!
Hmm?
Bazira told you to give it to me?
That's right, ma'am. Take this!
What is it?
Very precious, this one!
With this...!
You can use it to detect nearby artifacts!
Find more artifacts with this, and I'll fix them right up!
Hmm. So it's a kind of detector.
Thanks. I'll make good use of it.
That's right. We made it for ourselves, actually...
But it was too much for us to use.
That realm is way too dangerous... Lots of our friends fell...
And they didn't even have insurance...
That's... unfortunate.
N-Now you bring this out?
You must still be hiding more tools.
You'd better hand them all over. Otherwise...!
W-Waaah~! There's really nothing left!
Ooh, look at that, Sil.
That one is different from the ones we've seen before.
Sniff, sniff...
That thing smells like a witch.
What, don't tell me that's the Jewel Witch.
There really are witches of all shapes in the Garden.
A-As if that could be true...
What I'm saying is...
That thing was made with great care by the Jewel Witch.
So that's it.
Meaning it's different from everything we've met so far?
E-Exactly...
And it's probably worth much more...
Sil, can you defeat it without leaving a single scratch on its body?
Be reasonable.
Whatever it is, we have to defeat the thing blocking our path.
Ahh~ It all broke.
No matter how valuable a jewel is, if it blocks our path, it has to go.
I wonder if the Jewel Witch thinks the same way.
Hmm... The Jewel Witch.
Rims, you said you've met that witch before.
Tell me what she's like.
A haughty witch, I suppose...
In any case, she's fussy about everything.
I-If she learns we ran wild in her realm, she won't stay quiet.
If she cares about her realm that much, she should've stayed and protected it.
Hmm. On the other hand, it means a witch like that disappeared...
I can understand why Bazira is worried.
D-Don't worry. We'll find her soon...
We're going in the right direction, aren't we?
O-Of course. The farther we go, the stronger the witch's trace feels...
That is... Don't tell me...
Th-That has to be a nightmare.
Why would it appear in a place like this?!
Nightmares are supposed to appear in the Garden when Nahatra wakes up.
Sniff, sniff... Sniff, sniff...
What are you doing?
Th-This is the smell...!
D-Do you remember... when I said there was a strange smell?
Yes, when we first came here.
I-It looks like this is what it was.
You're right... Even to me, this feels out of place.
Its very shape is different from the nightmares we've seen before.
C-Can't we just go back now...?
I-I have a bad feeling about this...
I understand how you feel, but...
If a nightmare is involved, we can't ignore it.
Besides... If we pretend we didn't see it now, we'll definitely suffer more later.
Ugh...
When we find the Jewel Witch, I'm definitely going to ask her.
Why she needed such a huge realm.
I-I'm sure she'll answer like this.
Your realm is simply too small!
What I mean is... look at that.
Do you really need to put something like that there to protect a realm?
Sil, think about what that huge thing is protecting instead.
I'm sure the most precious treasures are gathered there.
Since we've come this far, let's take them all!
They don't have an owner anyway, right? Hehe...
Rims, could you please stop forgetting our objective?
Forget the treasure. I want to find the Jewel Witch and go home.
Aside from that place, there is nowhere else left to search...
W-Waaah...! It's moving!!
Please, Sil!
Sigh. Nothing ever goes smoothly.
Phew, it was huge but nothing special.
You're one to talk.
Ah. The door opened.
Looks like that thing was acting as the lock.
That has to be the source of the nightmare...
Hasn't the Jewel Witch already been devoured by the nightmare?
At the very least, we need to see what happened.
What's wrong?
N-No, it's just...
That strange feeling I sensed is getting stronger and stronger.
What I sense beyond there is definitely a witch's presence, but...
An ordinary witch couldn't have a smell like this.
I-I know it by instinct...
What do you mean?
S-Sorry...
It's the first time I've felt this... I don't know what it is...
I-It's just... kind of scary...
You're scared?
I never thought I'd hear that from you...
All right. From here, I'll go alone.
You watch from here, and if anything goes wrong...
You mean I should go to Nahatra, right?
Yes.
I-I will.
S-Sorry... that I can't go with you...
It's fine. Just keep an eye on the area.
The Jewel Witch might be somewhere nearby.
I've never seen Rims that scared before.
What on earth is beyond here?
A mirror...?
Is it some kind of cursed mirror?
It looks like the source of the problem. I should break it.
Huh...? M-My body is being pulled in...!
Waaah!!
Sil! The nightmare suddenly disappeared—
Huh...?
Sil~! Where did you go?
...Sil?
Ugh...
Where... am I...?
I was just... in another witch's realm...
...Ugh, I can't remember anything.
It's like my head is full of fog.
What is this place?
I know I've seen this place before...
But it feels like only a piece of it was cut out and put here.
Why can't I remember anything?
And why did I come here in the first place?
This isn't getting me anywhere. I should get moving.
